integrity: The rank and survival laws follow from an analytic Jacobi-matrix eigenbasis, a gcd divisibility argument, finite-dimensional dissipative spectral stability, and a roots-of-unity identity. The accompanying numerical checker tests finite instances only and is not the proof. Related prior spectral-projection and nodal-dark-state principles are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty even-sublattice loss patterns, odd homogeneous alternating open SSH chains, positive hopping and local loss rates, zero-temperature particle loss, and the one-particle/no-jump sector only. No assertion for general dephasing, interactions, gain, disorder, or arbitrary many-particle sectors. Population survival can converge while coherences persistently oscillate.
title: Arithmetic loss-pattern classification and survival plateaux in odd dissipative SSH chains
